refnamediv.refpurpose: Modifies the input vectors to give output vectors of the same length.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: [b, a] = eqtflength(b, a) [b, a, N, M] = eqtflength(b, a)

listitem.para: Vector. The numerator coefficients of the transfer function.
Vector. The denominator coefficients of the transfer function.
Integer. The length of the numerator vector after modification.
Integer. The length of the denominator vector after modification.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: This function modifies the input vectors `b` and `a` to ensure they have the same length by appending zeros to the shorter vector. It also returns the lengths of the modified numerator and denominator vectors.
